title: Guide for marking systems for fluid power components, Part 3: Pumps and motors
clause_1_scope: This standard ( Part 3 ) covers the mandatory and optional naarkings of industrial fluid power pumps and motors and states the manner of applying the markings. These specified markings serve as a guide to identify the manufacturer and the component, as well as to assist in proper application.
clause_3_terminology: Guide for marking systems for fluid power components
